description: Defines the CartStore class responsible for persisting shopping cart items locally using SharedPreferences and JSON serialization. It includes methods for loading, saving, and clearing cart data.

classes.name: CartStore
classes.description: A class for storing and retrieving shopping cart items using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cart items from SharedPreferences, returning an empty list if data is missing or corrupt.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves the provided list of cart items into SharedPreferences.
